title: Stranger in a Strange Land
author: Robert A. Heinlein
summary: A man raised by Martians returns to Earth as a young adult, with strange powers and no sense of human customs. As he learns our world, his questions start to shake up religion, sex and politics.
readIf: you like provocative, talky science fiction from the sixties that pokes at social rules.
skipIf: you want a tight plot or modern views, as some attitudes about gender have aged badly.

pairings.reason: Another outsider-on-a-strange-world novel about culture, gender and understanding, written more carefully.
A shorter, wittier satire on religion and science that works in a similar spirit.
